description: Required test suites for exact-head worker validation of the fixed coding pool. Every required suite must EXECUTE and PASS on the exact worker head. A missing tool, a missing test FILE, or a suite that produced no result is NOT_CONFIGURED (block). Any skipped required test is SKIPPED_BLOCKER (block). A non-zero run is EXECUTED_FAIL (block). Only EXECUTED_PASS satisfies a required suite. Each lane appends its OWN focused suites, and those suites name the finding's ACTUAL reviewed test files (not unrelated generic suites), so a worker head cannot pass while its assigned tests never execute. The lane is derived from the immutable issue/branch mapping (lane-mapping.json) and then the lane:<NAME> label must match it; a worker cannot select a weaker or unrelated recognized lane. CODEX-D1 is read-only and has no validated suite until an exact-SHA START_AUTHORIZATION; the cross-cutting critical findings (#1149/#1151/#1152/#1153/#1154/#1155) are dependencies, not lanes.
